title: Face Gumball Moves Whole Mesh
description: Face gumball drag still moves whole mesh instead of selected face vertices.
summary:
Face gumball transforms now pass selection mode and ids directly into WASM translate/rotate/scale, atomically applying component selection before deforming vertices.

- WASM API: translateSelection(mode, ids, …), rotateSelection(mode, ids, …), scaleSelection(mode, ids, …)
- Gumball drag end passes React selectionMode + selectedIds to session transforms
- Added normalizeLowpolySelectionMode (object → mesh) in controller and session bridge
- Rebuilt WASM pkg
